hooks.command: jq -e 'if (.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("project\\.pbxproj$") then halt_error("project.pbxproj is generated by XcodeGen. Edit project.yml + run `xcodegen generate` instead.") else . end' >/dev/null

jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(]|&&|\|\|)[[:space:]]*gh pr create' && { SIZE=$(wc -c < "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/CLAUDE.md" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); EXTRA=''; [ "$SIZE" -gt 45000 ] && EXTRA=" WARNING: the root CLAUDE.md is $SIZE bytes, over the 45 KB budget - move area rules out of it."; jq -cn --arg c "CLAUDE.md freshness gate: before creating this PR, review the full branch diff (git diff main...HEAD). Rules live next to the code: update the rules file of each AREA the diff touches (table 'Where the rules live' in the root CLAUDE.md - a folder CLAUDE.md, or docs/rules/*.md for a Shared/Screens feature), not the root file, unless the rule is cross-cutting. Covers new features/screens, new RULEs or gotchas, new @AppStorage keys (table in Shared/Screens/Settings/CLAUDE.md), new files for the Project Structure tree, changed defaults. If the docs are already up to date for this diff, proceed.$EXTRA" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:$c}}'; } || true
